proof_roadmap.step: Uniform fibre bounds and the maximum argument.

difficulty_reason: For a locally quasi-finite morphism f : X -> Y with X quasi-compact and a weighting w : X -> Z of f (the chapter's definition: a constructible function satisfying the weighting inequalities on fibres), the integral function int_f w on Y (sum of w over geometric fibres) attains a maximum. The retained proof is written: chapter lemma jumps-w plus Properties, lemma stratification-locally-finite-constructible give that w takes only finitely many values (its stratification is finite on the quasi-compact source); Morphisms, lemma locally-quasi-finite-qc-source-universally-bounded gives uniformly bounded geometric fibres; a sum over uniformly bounded sets of values from a finite set is bounded, and the bound is attained since the integral takes values in a finite set of integers; the maximum exists. Retained author proof at lines 22737-22746.
